X- Juvenile vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Heard Sri Himanshu Giri, learned counsel for the revisionist; Sri Nikhil Pathak, learned counsel for respondent no.4; learned AGA for State-respondents and perused the material on record.

This revision has been filed against the impugned order dated 13.3.2024 passed by Juvenile Justice Board, Hapur in case crime no. 337 of 2023 under sections 363,376(3),506 I.P.C. and section 3/4 (2) POCSO Act, P.S. Babugarh, District Hapur pending in the court of Juvenile Justice Board, Hapur whereby the Juvenile Justice Board, Hapur has declared the revisionist as adult for the purpose of his trial.

entities.text: POCSO Act, P.S. Babugarh, District Hapur
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
After the revisionist was declared juvenile aged about 17 years 5 months and one day, his preliminary assessment regarding commission of heinous offence was made by the J.J. Board,
Hapur.
Revisionist was examined by the clinical psychologist regarding his physical and mental capacity and his ability to understand the consequence of act committed by him.

Clinical physiologist conducted ?Vineland Social Maturity Scale " and found social age of the revisionist as 165 months and corresponding Social Quotient is 91.66 which indicate average level of social functioning of the revisionist
.J.J. Board, Hapur perused report of the D.P.O. and social investigation report and found that the social and economic condition of the revisionist is normal.
He was found to be physically and mentally normal.
Therefore Board found him liable to be tried as adult.
The order dated 13.3.2024 passed by J.J. Board, Hapur has been challenged in the above noted revision without availing the remedy of appeal.
After hearing rival submissions this court finds that revisionist was incarceration in child care protection home.

His preliminary assessment as per section 14(3)of Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015 was required to be done within period of three months from his first appearance before the court.

entities.text: Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: His preliminary assessment of age was made by order dated 20.11.2023 and order of preliminary assessment was passed on 13.3.2024 therefore clearly the preliminary assessment in case heinous offence was disposed of by the Board beyond period of three months provided under sections 14(3) of Act.

In view of the above, order dated 13.3.2024 passed by the J.J. Board, Hapur cannot be sustained X- Juvenile vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 6 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163279289/
2 and is set aside .
The revision is allowed.
The revisionist shall be tried as juvenile by J.J. Board, Hapur.

(Siddharth,J.) October 6, 2025 Atul kr. sri.
